title: Primus: Unified Training System for Large-Scale Deep Learning Recommendation Models
problem: Training large-scale deep learning recommendation models requires handling diverse model architectures, massive datasets, and heterogeneous data dependencies that existing training systems do not support in a unified manner.
motivation: Recommendation systems are critical infrastructure for internet-scale services, and efficient unified training directly reduces development time and operational resource consumption.
method: Primus provides a unified training framework that abstracts over recommendation model heterogeneity through standardized data loading and execution pipelines. It employs optimized scheduling and distributed parallelism strategies tailored to recommendation model memory access and computation patterns, integrating model-agnostic optimization across diverse recommendation architectures.
key_novelty: A unified training system architecture that standardizes the training pipeline across diverse recommendation model types at production scale.
contributions: Unified training framework supporting multiple recommendation model architectures
Large-scale distributed training with optimized scheduling for recommendation workloads
Integrated data loading and execution optimization pipeline
primary_theme: Unified training system for recommendation models
